originalTitle: SIF AUM jumps 29% to Rs 17,858 crore in June; inflows surge 171% MoM
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified version of the news item: Specialised Investment Funds (SIF) had a big increase in the amount of money they managed, with a 29% jump to Rs 17,858 crore in June. This happened because a lot more money was invested in these funds, with inflows increasing by 171% compared to the previous month. One type of SIF, called Hybrid Long-Short Funds, was particularly popular. The overall mutual fund industry also did well, with many investors putting in money, and a record number of people setting up regular investments. This suggests that individual investors are still very interested in putting their money into mutual funds.

originalTitle: DMart Q1 results: Cons PAT up 11% to Rs 860 crore, revenue rises to Rs 18,795 crore
simplifiedContent: Avenue Supermarts, the company that owns DMart, just released its financial results for the first quarter of the year. The company made a profit of Rs 860 crore, which is 11% more than it made during the same time last year. Its total revenue, or the amount of money it made from selling things, also increased by 14.9% to Rs 18,795 crore. This increase in profit and revenue is a good sign for the company, and it shows that the company is performing well. The company's overall financial health, measured by a metric called EBITDA, also grew by 15.4%, which is another positive sign.

originalTitle: Nearly 60% of foreign inflows into India-focused funds withdrawn since 2024 peak: Report
simplifiedContent: Foreign investors have taken out almost 60% of their money from funds that focus on Indian stocks since the peak in 2024. This means they are choosing to put their money elsewhere, such as in companies that work with artificial intelligence. In 2026, $9 billion was withdrawn from India-focused funds, showing a significant shift in investment choices. At the same time, some investors put money into gold funds and US stocks, while Europe also saw some new investment. This change in investment patterns is likely to have an impact on the Indian stock market and economy.

originalTitle: Nomura sees 22% upside in Ather Energy. Here's why it's the brokerage's top EV pick
simplifiedContent: A company called Nomura thinks that Ather Energy, a company that makes electric vehicles, is a good investment. They believe the company's stock price will go up by 22% because they think Ather Energy will do very well as more people switch to electric vehicles. Nomura has set a target price of ₹1,470 for Ather Energy's stock, which means they think it will reach that price. This makes Ather Energy Nomura's top choice for investing in electric vehicle companies. Nomura is giving Ather Energy a "Buy" rating, which means they think people should invest in the company.

originalTitle: Why large cap and mid cap funds could be the best mutual fund to bet on now, according to Abakkus study
simplifiedContent: A recent study by Abakkus Mutual Fund found that large and mid-sized company funds might be a good investment choice right now. This is because company earnings are getting better and the prices of these investments are reasonable. The stock market has recently gone down, which can be a good time for long-term investors to get in. This could mean that the price of stocks will eventually match the growth in company earnings, making it a potentially good time to invest. The study suggests that now might be a good time to consider investing in these types of funds for the long term.

originalTitle: AI chip fever returns? SK Hynix  share price surges 13% after blockbuster $26.5 billion US listing
simplifiedContent: SK Hynix, a company that makes computer chips, just listed its shares on the US stock market and raised a lot of money - $26.5 billion. The company's share price jumped up 13% on its first day, which is a big increase. This is notable because other similar companies in the semiconductor industry have been experiencing ups and downs lately. The strong demand for SK Hynix's shares suggests that investors are excited about the company's potential, especially since its products are used in artificial intelligence technology. This could be a good sign for the company and its investors, as it shows that people are willing to invest in companies that make chips used in AI.
